metadata.title: Email Collaboration Platform - LISTSERV SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan governing email-based collaboration platforms (e.g., LISTSERV) used for moderated, opt-in group discussion among institutional users.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security, privacy, records, and acceptable use baseline.

system-characteristics.system-description: Institutional email collaboration platform supporting opt-in, invitation-based discussion lists for internal communities, projects, or interests, with two-way human communication and archived discussions.

information-type.title: Discussion List Message Content
information-type.description: Email messages posted to and distributed via discussion lists.

information-type.title: Discussion List Membership Data
information-type.description: Invitation, subscription, and opt-out state for discussion list participants.

information-type.title: Discussion List Archives
information-type.description: Archived discussion messages retained per configuration and records requirements.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: Discussion list participation inherits Individual Email SSPP identity, monitoring, disclosure, and lifecycle constraints.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: Discussion lists are implemented on the Secure Email Platform.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: This SSPP implements the Email Collaboration Gateway pattern for email-based workflows.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Domain authentication, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC enforcement apply to discussion list traffic.

props.name: usage-intent
props.remarks: Discussion lists support two-way collaborative email communication among internal participants.

props.name: membership-model
props.remarks: Membership is invitation-based and optional; users are not automatically enrolled.

props.name: opt-out-requirement
props.remarks: Participants MUST be able to opt out promptly and without undue burden.

props.name: membership-review
props.remarks: List owners MUST periodically review and attest to current membership appropriateness.

props.name: recipient-scope
props.remarks: Discussion lists are restricted to institutional users (students, staff, faculty, librarians, affiliates); external participants are prohibited.

props.name: posting-model
props.remarks: Only subscribed members may post; automated posting and application integration are prohibited.

props.name: communication-model
props.remarks: Messages sent to the list are distributed to all subscribed members.

props.name: volume-constraint
props.remarks: Discussion lists must not be used for campaigns, announcements at scale, or bulk messaging.

props.name: escalation-requirement
props.remarks: One-way announcements or large-scale messaging must use Distribution Groups or the Email Campaign Platform.

props.name: automation-constraint
props.remarks: Applications, scripts, and automated systems MUST NOT post to discussion lists.

props.name: data-classification-constraint
props.remarks: Discussion list content MUST NOT include or reference information classified at Level 4 or higher.

props.name: archive-policy
props.remarks: Discussion archives must be explicitly configured and governed according to institutional records and retention policy.

props.name: auditability
props.remarks: All discussion list posts MUST be attributable to the individual sender.

props.name: disclosure-authority
props.remarks: Disclosure of discussion list content occurs only under lawful or formally authorized institutional processes.

system-implementation.remarks: The email collaboration service enforces opt-in membership, authenticated posting, archive governance, and centralized monitoring.

components.title: Email Collaboration Discussion List
components.description: Email-based discussion list supporting moderated, opt-in collaboration.

roles.title: Discussion List Owner
roles.remarks: Accountable for list purpose, membership invitations, reviews, moderation, and lifecycle.

roles.title: Discussion List Member
roles.remarks: Subscribed participant authorized to post to and receive discussion messages.

control-implementation.remarks: All controls are inherited from Individual Email SSPP and Secure Email Platform SSPP, with additional constraints for collaboration, membership governance, and archives.
